video_title: Vince Carter & T-Mac Recall Their Coaches’ Wildest Comments & The Times They Got Posterized

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Butch Carter's blunt advice before the NBA All-Star dunk contest
quotes.excerpt: Y'all go out there and have fun, and don't come back and break your damn arms, legs and neck.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: I do remember Butch Carter telling us when we were going for the dunk contest, All-Star weekend. It was wild because we were young and coaches say so many things. He said, y'all go out there and have fun, and don't come back and break your damn arms, legs and neck.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: That's an old head saying right there, boy.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeff Van Gundy's blunt message to Tracy McGrady in Houston
quotes.excerpt: I know you led the league in scoring the last two years, that's not going to happen here.
quotes.quote: I remember coming off of two scoring titles and then after my second one, I go to Houston and one of my first meetings and conversations with Jeff Van Gundy, he told me, well, I know you led the league in scoring the last two years, that's not going to happen here. I was like, what? Damn, you just going to tell me in my face? You're just going to tell me what I ain't going to do? And then I understood once he broke it down because I'm playing with the big fella, Yao.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeff Van Gundy's strict body fat requirements for Rockets players
quotes.excerpt: Jeff comes from that Pat Riley tree to where body fat got to be a certain percentage.
quotes.quote: Jeff comes from that Pat Riley tree to where body fat got to be a certain percentage when you come into training camp before you even step on the basketball court. You got to have your body fat right. So, got a player struggling, and throughout the season, training camp and throughout the year, he will come in, nobody shooting, there's no basketballs, and we just know what time it is. Everybody going to line up on the side, sitting down, and individually he's going down and telling you what your role is.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeff Van Gundy's public embarrassment of a struggling Rockets player
quotes.excerpt: What are you? You on a milk carton somewhere? Huh? We can't find you.
quotes.quote: He got to this one particular player and mind you, we in the middle of the season. He's like, in such and such, where the f*** are you? What are you? You on a milk carton somewhere? Huh? We can't find you. You on a milk carton? I was like, I'm laughing. I'm next to Juwan. Juwan was scared to laugh because Jeff, you know, Jeff is so serious. I don't give a f***, I'm laughing. He was going to embarrass this man in front of the whole team like that, talking about, where are you? Are you on a milk carton? I was like, oh my god, I can't believe this man said this in front of the whole team to this kid. And he was struggling, and yes, he was on a milk carton because his ass was missing and we needed him because he was one of our shooters.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter and Tracy McGrady recall their mutual posterization
quotes.excerpt: It was a tip dunk that I went up and got and it jumped and I ended up dunking on your head.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: In Toronto, it was a tip dunk that I went up and got and it jumped and I ended up dunking on your head. You look back and you're like, yo, what? And I was like, yo, my bad. And it ended up you did the same back to me. You got a tip dunk, I was going and you just went a little higher and dunked on me in Toronto.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Love's poster dunk on Vince Carter in Minnesota
quotes.excerpt: He was a younger guy than me and the player said to me many, many years ago, Kevin Love.
quotes.quote: There is another player that dunked on me and I was at the left elbow, this player is at the right block. They threw him the ball. I look, he takes one dribble. I'm looking, I'm trying to be athletic and try to go get the block, just he wide open, no layups. And as I get there, he kind of two-hand just. And he was a younger guy than me and the player said to me many, many years ago, Kevin Love, who it was. Yeah, Kevin Love. Minnesota. It wasn't like terrible, but for me, it was terrible for the simple fact that he did it because, and this is so random, but when he won Gatorade Player of the Year in high school, he received the award, he looked at me and he said, oh, I'm going to be up there with you one of these days. I said, cool, I'll be there. And then we fast forward, he dunked it and when he dunked, I was like, oh my god, in Minnesota, if I'm not mistaken, and I just remember running down like, oh my god.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady's defensive strategy against Allan Houston
quotes.excerpt: I had to guard Sprewell, Allan Houston. So we playing the Knicks, I'm guarding Allan Houston.
quotes.quote: Butch used to put me on the offensive players and let your ass be free in scoring. So I had to guard Sprewell, Allan Houston. So we playing the Knicks, I'm guarding Allan Houston. And I always, like for me, I can read if I'm quicker than my guy and I just got a good feel for how I need to guard this dude. I misjudged him because I didn't think he was, you know, uber athletic. I wasn't worried about him trying to go up and explode over and dunk. Man, he made a move, I'm guarding, he made a move and boom, boom, went up. I thought it was Allan Houston. Yeah, he had bounce.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Miller's quick dunk attempt on Tracy McGrady
quotes.excerpt: Andre Miller tried to get me like that. He tried to quick dunk me too.
quotes.quote: Andre Miller tried to get me like that. He tried to quick dunk me too. I love, I thank goodness he missed it. He was one of my favorite players. Man, he was so good. Yeah, he was so good. So good.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter's annoyance with how players tie their shoelaces
quotes.excerpt: It just used to bother me how he tied his shoes.
quotes.quote: It just used to bother me how he tied his shoes. What you mean? He didn't tie them? No, he would tie he his laces were so long and he tied the shoe and then wrap them around his ankles and tie it there. Like I, I remember the first time I saw it, he did it in Utah when we played them in the Final Four and they ended up beating us. But I was like, I had never seen that before. I'm like, but I'm like, how, first of all, how's your laces long enough to do that? That's funny. And he proceeded to give us a triple-double. I said, you can tie them how you want to, but you do that. That's funny. He gave us the blues.
